name: Mate
description: Yerba mate steeped in a gourd and drunk hot through a bombilla, passed around.

tcm.note: Outside the classical record; read with tea; a bitter caffeinated infusion.

ayurveda.note: Outside the classical record; tikta and caffeinated.

unani.note: Outside the classical record; outside the record.

histamine.note: SIGHI groups mate with green tea: mild in itself, and a DAO blocker.

stimulant.note: As yerba mate — caffeine alongside theobromine and a little theophylline.

guna.note: Stimulating, which is the definition of rajasic rather than a judgement on it.
